name: [Istio] istio-proxy memory growing steadily — possible leak — {{pod_name.name}}
message:
:chart_with_upwards_trend: **istio-proxy memory is up {{value}}% versus 4 hours ago and has not levelled off.**

Pod: `{{kube_namespace.name}}/{{pod_name.name}}`
Cluster: `{{kube_cluster_name.name}}`

This is the early-warning monitor. It fires on the *shape* of the curve rather than on an absolute level, so it catches a leak hours before the saturation monitor would — while there is still time to roll back or restart on your own schedule rather than the OOM killer's.

Expect this one to be noisier than the others. A pod that started recently is still filling its working set and will trip this legitimately; `new_group_delay` covers the first 5 minutes but not a slow warm-up. If it is noisy in your mesh, raise the threshold rather than muting it — a leak that is real will keep climbing past any threshold you set.

**Triage**
1. Confirm the climb is monotonic on the *leak detector* panel, not a sawtooth.
2. `istioctl proxy-config all <pod> -n <ns>` — if config size grew at the same time, this is config growth, not a leak.
3. If it is a genuine leak, note the Istio version and check the upstream issue tracker before rolling back.
